newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume jumps.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume jumps.

text.p: Traded volume on Istanbul's gold exchange jumped on Monday due to firmer free market demand but prices were mixed, dealers said.
Volume was 1,067 kilos, up sharply from Friday's 667 kilos and Thursday's 202 kilos and 65 percent of it was in lira terms due to a weaker lira.
Gold closed 900 lira firmer at 1,138,400 lira per gram as the lira eased to 92,875 to the dollar from Friday's 92,520. In dollar terms, it dropped to $380.30 an ounce from Friday's $381.10 close.

"Cash returning to the gold market after the weekend and closer dollar rates on the interbank and the free market fuelled gold demand in the first session," said Yusuf Kiremitci from Sembol Doviz foreign exchange and gold trade firm.
He said activity died down in the afternoon as demand was saturated. Only 80 kilos of gold changed hands in the second session.
